title: Chlamydia screening in women 25 years or older at increased risk

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for chlamydia in all sexually active women 24 years or younger and in women 25 years or older who are at increased risk for infection.

uncomputable.needs: clinical assessment of increased risk for chlamydia infection (sexual history/risk factors)

derived.window: screening interval is not stated in the text; a measurement-year (annual) window is assumed and needs human review
